proposed_facts.reason: Canonical branch ordering decrements a nonzero entry timer and returns even when it reaches zero. Emission occurs on a subsequent zero-entry invocation, supporting reload-plus-one spacing. The initializer supplies 20/40/100 and 8/4/2, initializes every slot, and installs a callback invoked only for physical ports. The functionality document agrees.

The accessor returns trigger without mutation. HSD computes physical rising edges; the any-source helper aliases trigger independently of held state, the chord helper additionally requires current chord buttons, and aggregation ORs port triggers. Thus another source or port can retrigger an already-held semantic command, as the document explains.
